as_of_note: Research judgment on the frozen 6 November 2026 packet. Not an order and not a book update.
research_question: Is the AI/credit selloff creating a sustained growth trade, or an opportunity to fade an overreaction?
answer: Neither add. The 5 November equity drop is real and the US front end had already been rallying, while oil rebounded in the same session. That mix does not identify a sustained growth trade to add, and it does not identify a clean overreaction to fade. The owned CORRA receive stays on, at the size the adverse path and the loss budget buy. The owned EURUSD long stays at its current size. AUDJPY, AUDNZD, and SR3 stay flat.
sign_convention: pnl_usd positive means the expression makes money from the frozen reference. Financing is a separate positive cost and is not an edge.

cards.entry_now: Cut now from the incumbent USD 100,000,000 to the budget-implied size. Reference is the frozen equal-weight implied average 3.05125. Observation dates on CRAH27, CRAM27, CRAU27, and CRAZ27 are null.
cards.wait_alternative: Wait for the average to print 3.02, the near edge of the judgmental range, and only then hold the residual.
cards.cost_of_waiting: The nearer edge is 3.125 bp from 3.05125, about USD 31,250 at the incumbent USD 100,000,000 and about USD 14,970 at the sized notional. Waiting gives that compression away and still carries the 20.875 bp adverse until the cut.
cards.target_label: Judgmental range for the equal-weight average, not a fair value and not a Bank of Canada forecast. Built by leaving H and M near 2.885 and 3.01 and allowing U and Z to compress. A 2.75 neutral proxy is not used.
cards.repricing_horizon: 8 to 12 weeks. Financing horizon used below is 70 calendar days.
cards.yardstick: CA_2Y daily differences in bp, proxy only. No CORRA strip history. Sample is 126 points and 125 changes, not the stored n of 252. Full-sample standard deviation 4.99 bp. Last 20 observations are 19 changes, standard deviation 5.58 bp. Full-sample standard deviation times square root of 40 trading days is 31.6 bp, and times square root of 60 is 38.7 bp. Convention, not a probability.
cards.falsifier: Equal-weight average at or above 3.26. Or WTI back at the 30 October close 104.12, or Brent back at 117.64, with the underlying Canadian inflation score impulse turning up. Or a later packet in which Canadian labor is actually available and reaccelerates with a warmer underlying score. Or Bank of Canada communication on the 9 December 2026 date that validates the higher 2027 path. The rebound to WTI 90.52 does not qualify.
cards.practical_exit: Exit the residual if the average trades at or through 3.26. Gap through that level is reviewed at 3.40, which is both the original entry and CRAZ28. No resting order. Time review inside 8 to 12 weeks, and again at the 9 December 2026 calendar date.
cards.size_label: Budget-implied. The discrete USD 50,000,000 comparison loses USD 104,375 on the same path, USD 4,375 over the budget. The budget was not raised to defend USD 100,000,000 or to force a round 50,000,000.
cards.dv01_identity: Book identity USD 10,000 per bp per USD 100,000,000, parallel move of the equal-weight average. Confirmed by 29.125 bp from 3.40 to 3.10875 equaling stored unrealized USD 291,250. This is four times a single quarterly-contract convention of USD 25 per bp per USD 1,000,000 and is not applied to SR3.

target_payoff_usd.label: Nearest dollar at the sized notional. The two edges are not averaged and are not an expected value.

cards.target_label: Retested judgmental references, not fair value. 1.1356 is the prior arithmetic marker and is left on 1.1267 rather than rolled onto 1.1224. 1.1467 is the median of the 126 closes in this packet. The prior 1.1472 was an earlier median.
cards.repricing_horizon: 8 to 12 weeks. Financing horizon 70 calendar days.
cards.yardstick: EURUSD own daily log returns, 126 points, 125 returns, not stored n of 252. Changes are stored as 100 times the log. Full-sample standard deviation 0.31 percent log. Last 20 observations, 19 returns, 0.31 percent log. Full-sample standard deviation times square root of 40 trading days is 1.96 percent log, and times square root of 60 is 2.41 percent log. Convention, not a probability. The move from 1.1224 to the 1.1179 review is 0.0045, and 21 of 125 absolute daily level changes were at least 0.0045, counting the 2026-10-16 move of exactly 0.0045.

cards.pnl_identity: paper USD = notional * (new / reference - 1). Not an exchange lot.
